name: com.excubitorsecurity/domain-check
title: Excubitor
description: Check a domain's email and website security: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, certificate, headers.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Checks a domain in a few seconds, from public information only: SPF, DKIM and DMARC (can someone send email in this domain's name?), the website's certificate expiry, security headers, the domain registration date and DNS mistakes that silently break email. Returns a plain-language diagnosis, the findings by priority (urgent, fix, can wait) with what to do for each, a link to the full report with the evidence, and a link to be warned by email when something changes. Free, no account.

domain.description: The domain to check, for example mycompany.com. A full URL is accepted.

language.description: Language of the answer: en (English, default), pt (Portuguese) or es (Spanish).
